name: Summer Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help library staff with the Summer Reading program. Do it at a Phoenix library branch. Help for at least 4 weeks.
duration: At least 4 weeks over the summer, plus one online orientation and branch training
deadline_text: 2026 applications opened in April 2026 (release dated April 10, 2026). No deadline posted. Positions fill fast.
how_to_apply: Follow the steps on phoenixpubliclibrary.org/teens/summer-teen-volunteers. Then staff contact you for an interview. Turn in a signed Volunteer PHX Permission Form and waiver by your first day.
notes: Based on the 2026 cycle. Expect applications again in spring 2027. Four online orientations were offered in May.
